about_the_game:
Island Mojo Blocks is a casual city builder and survival game, with unique delivery and production network management. Quick strategy and planning are key to survival in this fun and challenging adventure!

Meet growing tourism demand by building a sustainable island community and production network. Arriving tourists will not leave the island until they consume the requested goods. Your mission is to organize an efficient production and delivery network, so tourists can get their food and leave the island as soon as possible. If there is no place for new tourist arrivals at staying hotels and campsites, the game is over. The key is to efficiently organize truck and drone routes to deliver required goods where they are needed. Organizing deliveries in a smart driving loop increases the chances of game success.

Features:

• Each island tile has specific production, community, and tourism characteristics!

• Build homes and assign citizens to work in production buildings. Make smart decisions on where to build homes to increase citizens' productivity.

• Use drones and trucks to pick up and deliver required goods in a loop, organizing a good delivery network.

• Plan roads wisely, organize efficient delivery routes with trucks and drones, and provide essential food and drinks.

• Export required goods to earn more money, and the equipment that is needed for the island's development.

• Build community buildings to increase citizens' productivity in the area.

• Build tourist spots to earn more resources. Wisely choose where to build tourist spots to earn more money.

• The game includes 24 unique challenges, each with a special setup and characteristics.

• Earn a point for each tourist that leaves the island.

• Each challenge has its own hall of fame list with the best 100 results from all players worldwide.

Can you handle the tourist boom and develop island mojo? Success will boost your island rating and may even earn you a spot in the challenge hall of fame with other players around the world!
